description: Numeric BTS airport ids in flights.csv resolved to IATA codes by resolve:airport-ids. Derived offline from schedule matches, not from an official crosswalk.
method: Key = (airline, flightNumber, schedDepMin, schedArrMin). Reference months with IATA codes give key -> (origin, dest); keys seen with more than one pair are discarded. Each row with a numeric id whose key matches votes id -> IATA (origin and dest roles counted together).
